articles.title: A 91-Year-Old Just Hiked 2,198 Miles — and Set a Record
articles.summary: Dale Sanders, 91, became the oldest person to hike the whole Appalachian Trail. The 2,198-mile trip took him 359 days — and he fell 71 times along the way.

articles.title: Kids Across America Turned Big Questions Into Podcasts
articles.summary: NPR's Student Podcast Challenge got nearly 1,500 podcasts from kids in 42 states. Topics ranged from Andy Warhol to dementia to what it means to be American.

articles.title: Hailee Steinfeld Is a Witch in Her New Disney Movie 'Hexed'
articles.summary: Hailee Steinfeld just told Jimmy Fallon about her new Disney movie, 'Hexed.' She voices a teen witch named Billie Doe. The film comes out this Thanksgiving.
